in_sanskrit.name: कृष्ण
in_sanskrit.meaning: darkness, all-pervading, all-attractive, God of compassion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is all-attractive, the one who is the cause of all causes, the one who is the source of all beings, the one who is the cause of darkness in this material world to give devotees a chance to surrender unto Him, and the one who is the embodiment of God's mercy.

in_hindi.name: कृष्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name 'Krishna' is a nickname for Lord Krishna, who is the eighth avatar of Lord Vishnu and is also known as 'Krishna-Kar' or 'Krishna the dark one'. He is considered the god of compassion, the embodiment of love and the giver of moral values.

in_tamil.name: கிருஷ்ணா
in_tamil.long_meaning: This name 'Krishna' in Tamil means 'the one who is the cause of the universe', 'the one who is the giver of knowledge', 'the one who is the destroyer of sorrow', and 'the one who is the embodiment of love'.

in_telugu.name: కృష్ణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: This name 'Krishna' in Telugu means 'the one who is the cause of the universe', 'the one who is the giver of knowledge', 'the one who is the lord', and 'the one who is the embodiment of love'.

in_marathi.name: Kittu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Little one, cub
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kittu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kittu is derived from the Hindi word 'kitab' which means 'book'. It is often used as a nickname or term of endearment for a little boy or a cub. In Hindu mythology, the god Hanuman is also referred to as 'Kittu' due to his devotion and strength. This name is rich in symbolism, representing wisdom, devotion, and strength.
